description: A first-order theory \(T\) is complete if and only if it is satisfiable and all its nonempty models are elementarily equivalent.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.Theory.IsComplete.isComplete_iff_models_elementarily_equivalent.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {T : L.Theory} : T.IsComplete ↔ T.IsSatisfiable ∧ ∀ (M N : T.ModelType), L.ElementarilyEquivalent ↑M ↑N
